# Ref reference

A ref ties a card to something outside Orion: a pull request, an issue, or a branch. `--ref` takes one in any of these forms, and Orion stores it as a key. Queries and selectors match refs by that key.

```sh
orion card set <id> --ref https://github.com/gummy-galaxy/orion/pull/86
```

Forms are tried in this order.

| Form                                                | Refers to                                                                                                                           | Example                                            | Key                                     |
| --------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `https://github.com/<owner>/<name>/pull/<number>`   | A GitHub pull request.                                                                                                              | `https://github.com/gummy-galaxy/orion/pull/86`    | `gummy-galaxy/orion#86`                 |
| `https://github.com/<owner>/<name>/issues/<number>` | A GitHub issue.                                                                                                                     | `https://github.com/gummy-galaxy/orion/issues/146` | `gummy-galaxy/orion#146`                |
| `https://<host>/<owner>/<name>/pull/<number>`       | A pull request on GitHub Enterprise, or an issue with `/issues/`. Its key starts with the host. Needs a GitHub source for the host. | `https://github.example.com/owner/name/pull/12`    | `github.example.com/owner/name#12`      |
| `<browse URL>/<KEY>`                                | A Jira issue, by its URL. Needs a Jira source whose browse URL starts the link.                                                     | `https://jira.example.com/browse/ABC-12`           | `ABC-12`                                |
| `<source>:<KEY>`                                    | A Jira issue, by its key and the id of the source it belongs to. Needs a Jira source with that id.                                  | `jira:ABC-12`                                      | `ABC-12`                                |
| `branch:<owner>/<name>@<branch>`                    | The branch work started on, keyed the way hop keys branches. The first `@` ends the repository.                                     | `branch:gummy-galaxy/orion@agent/196-attach`       | `gummy-galaxy/orion@agent/196-attach`   |
| `branch:<host>/<owner>/<name>@<branch>`             | A branch on GitHub Enterprise. Needs a GitHub source for the host.                                                                  | `branch:github.example.com/owner/name@feature`     | `github.example.com/owner/name@feature` |

With no sources configured, only github.com pull requests, issues, and branches resolve. [Sources](/guide/sources) explains adding GitHub and Jira sources.
